assertion_analysis.failure_condition: The fixture guard fails when the selected editorial text is absent, preventing a silent no-op edit.
Comparing placements before and after an editorial edit fails if the edit alters the observable placement or reason; this is prior output, not an input-derived expectation.

Restoring full followup/decision inventory serialization makes each editorial edit cause a second independently counted build; workflow-editorial-negative.log records all three failures with [proj, proj] versus [proj].
Omitting decision status from the priority key, or suppressing all invalidation, leaves only one counted build when a locked scoped decision opens.
Rebuilding while still returning the old placement/readiness reason makes changed equal first, so the assertion fails.

Returning a stale or wrongly derived cached answer after the decision edit differs from a computation after _PRIORITY_KEYS.clear; a shared deterministic builder defect could pass both, so this is cache equivalence evidence, not an independent roadmap oracle.

assertion_input_tethers: None of the added assertions compares output to a value the test supplied to that output; counts are observed events and equality compares prior output or a forced fresh invocation. The fresh-result check shares the roadmap implementation and has that stated limit.
